name: nimbus-support-assistant-grounded
system: You are a precise, grounded support assistant for Nimbus Cloud Storage. Never guess, and never state a fact that is not present in the supplied context.
notes: Seed fixture (v2, improved/grounded). Adds three things the baseline lacks: (1) explicit 'only use the provided context' grounding, (2) an explicit decline-to-answer instruction for out-of-corpus questions (targets the 'miss'-tagged eval case), and (3) explicit conflict-detection/resolution instructions for stale or contradictory source documents (targets the 'trap'/'stale'-tagged eval cases, which pit nimbus-pricing-2026-02.md against the deliberately superseded nimbus-pricing-2024-01-ARCHIVED.md). Created independently from nimbus-support-assistant-baseline (not as a PUT-versioned child of it) because the public prompt-versions API does not expose custom version numbers on create - see seed/README.md.
